test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A rectangular tin sheet is 17 cm long and 22 cm wide. It is rolled along its width to form a cylinder, with opposite edges just touching each other. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a sheet is rolled along its **width**, the width becomes the **circumference** (C) and the length becomes the **height** (h).

C = 22 cm ⇒ 2πr = 22 ⇒ r = 11/π cm

Volume = πr²h = π × (11/π)² × 17

Volume = π × (121/π²) × 17 = 2057/π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2057/π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length of **rectangular sheet** (l) = 17 cm, Width (w) = 22 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of **cylinder** = πr²h; Circumference = 2πr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/504a4291cc5ecaa9e6e66f158c753280eb8d9f3c8497f7c1c1d672ee32751470.png] 

⇒ When rolled along the **width**, the **circumference** of the base of the cylinder = 22 cm.

⇒ 2 × π × r = 22

⇒ r = 22 / (2π) = 11/π cm

⇒ The **height** (h) of the cylinder = 17 cm

⇒ Volume = π × (11/π)² × 17

⇒ Volume = π × (121/π²) × 17

⇒ Volume = (121 × 17) / π

⇒ Volume = 2057/π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2057/π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Rolling Rules

If rolled along length 'L', then 2πr = L and h = width. If rolled along width 'W', then 2πr = W and h = length.

Surface Area of Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh. Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

Volume = Base Area × Height = πr²h.</p
